description: This source file belongs to a network utility module, specifically implementing ping functionality with methods to execute ping commands, parse results, and handle named endpoint pings within a plugin namespace.

methods.name: _doPing
methods.description: Performs a ping to the specified endpoint, parses the command output, and returns a JSON object with ping statistics and status.

methods.name: _doPingNamedEndpoint
methods.description: Performs a ping to a predefined named endpoint such as 'CMTS' by resolving it to a gateway and delegating to _doPing.
